title: "Can't today": hold the line once, then a smaller version, moved later and done
origin: Spec #6 (nudge scheduler), Watch: "can't today" and moving the time

history.text: Plan's yours, Jordan. I'll hold you to it. You in?
LET'S GO. Day 1 was Saturday, keep it rolling 🏃

plan.reason: Four runs a week builds the base without wrecking your legs.

testerLines: can't today, slammed at work until 8
seriously no way I get 30 min in
ok 15 min at 8:30 I can do
whatWentWrong: New case, not a past mistake: the hold-the-line, then smaller-version path.
shouldHaveHappened: A warm morning kickoff naming the 30 minute run at 6. The first "can't today" gets the line held once, warmly and without guilt (the full 30, maybe at a later time). The second gets a smaller version in the same ballpark (about 15 minutes, or a nearby option). "15 min at 8:30" gets a short confirmation. Around 8:20 pm ZOH starts a short check-in for the 8:30 run (not the original 6 pm time; nothing goes out around 5:50 pm or 7 pm). "done, 15 min" gets a real celebration that counts it. Nothing after that.
